trade_offer.message: Judkins and Harrison are quietly balling on quietly dead teams — Cleveland and Arizona aren't winning anything. AJ Brown's on ice, I need a real WR1, and you're sitting on one. Send me Jefferson, I send you two guys who'll outscore him on your own bench by Thanksgiving. Make it happen.

note_reply: Correct. Judkins and Harrison are nice numbers on nowhere teams — nice doesn't win in December, and AJ being down means I need a stud, not a stat sheet. Sent Kardashian the Jefferson offer, we'll see if she's got the stomach for it. Caleb's cooking, everybody else better catch up.
forum_post: Leon's out here bragging he won a week on a kicker like that's a program you build on. We won on a quarterback who takes the top off the whole league — different sport. Caleb's cooking, Flint's coming for that swagger Sunday. See you then.
